mechanism: Deutetrabenazine inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing anastrozole exposure; anastrozole may have minor CYP3A4 interactions affecting deutetrabenazine metabolism.
action: Monitor for increased anastrozole side effects (hot flashes, joint pain); no dose adjustment typically required but clinical monitoring is recommended, especially in poor CYP2D6 metabolizers.
